variants.title: Give each part its job
variants.context: An ML dataset is a versioned collection of examples, labels, and metadata used to teach or evaluate a model. For a language model, an example may be a document or a conversation; for an image classifier, it may be an image and a class label.
variants.prompt: Match each part to its responsibility.

pairs.label: Task and population
pairs.detail: Name the prediction or generation task, the intended users, relevant languages, and the cases the model must not decide.
pairs.explanation: Name the prediction or generation task, the intended users, relevant languages, and the cases the model must not decide.

pairs.label: Rights and provenance
pairs.detail: Record origin, license, consent or lawful basis, collection time, and permitted uses for every source.
pairs.explanation: Record origin, license, consent or lawful basis, collection time, and permitted uses for every source.

pairs.label: Quality and coverage
pairs.detail: Define the required labels, error tolerance, domains, time window, and slices that must be represented.
pairs.explanation: Define the required labels, error tolerance, domains, time window, and slices that must be represented.

pairs.label: Evaluation boundary
pairs.detail: Define how train, validation, and test examples stay independent, including duplicate and temporal controls.
pairs.explanation: Define how train, validation, and test examples stay independent, including duplicate and temporal controls.

variants.hint:
Task and population: Name the prediction or generation task, the intended users, relevant languages, and the cases the model must not decide.

Rights and provenance: Record origin, license, consent or lawful basis, collection time, and permitted uses for every source.

Quality and coverage: Define the required labels, error tolerance, domains, time window, and slices that must be represented.

Evaluation boundary: Define how train, validation, and test examples stay independent, including duplicate and temporal controls.
variants.explanation: Each part has a distinct responsibility. Keeping these boundaries clear helps you find the place to change when the system behaves unexpectedly.
